title: Mobility Equipment Warehouse Note — Tire Settling Between Order and Delivery
content:
# Tire-Settling Allowance — Mobility Equipment

**Note.** A tire-settling allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty tire or caster replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the days from the chair's order date to its delivery date: 2 units for 21 days or more, 1 unit for at least 7 but fewer than 21 days, and nothing for fewer than 7 days.

## Bands

- fewer than 7 days between the order date and the delivery date — none;
- 7 to 20 days — 1 unit;
- 21 days or more — 2 units.

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical, order received 3 June)

| Delivered | Days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | 6 | none |
| 10 June | 7 | 1 unit |
| 23 June | 20 | 1 unit |
| 24 June | 21 | 2 units |

Both dates are those on the chair's wheelchair record.
